// Package unformatted holds the shapes gofmt would rewrite, which the original still judges: parentheses around a
// ranged source and doubled ones, and an empty statement after the store.
package unformatted

func loops() {
	var source, destination []int
	var first, second [4]int
	for index, value := range (source) {
		destination[index] = value
	}
	for index, value := range ((source)) {
		((destination))[((index))] = ((value))
	}
	for index := range (source) {
		destination[index] = ((source))[index]
	}
	for index := range ((first)) {
		((second))[index] = (first)[index]
	}
	for index := 0; ((index)) < ((len))(((source))); ((index))++ {
		destination[index] = ((source))[index]
	}
	for index, value := range source {
		destination[index] = value;
	}
	for index, value := range source {
		destination[index] = value;;
	}
	for index, value := range source {
		{ destination[index] = value; }
	}
}
